name: dn-empty-attribute-value-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees directoryName is C=US,O=Example. The leaf subject's O attribute carries an empty string value: C=US,O=,CN=Alice. X.520 requires the organizationName value length to be in [1,64], so the leaf's O attribute is malformed; even setting that aside, the empty string is not equal to 'Example' under RFC 5280 7.1's string preparation, so the leaf is outside the permitted subtree.
notes: Built via the per-AVA `validate: false` flag so cryptography emits the empty UTF8String the X.520 length check would otherwise reject. A validator that compares attribute values with strncmp(constraint, leaf, strlen(constraint)) wrongly accepts the empty string as a prefix match — even though the constraint is much longer.
